title: Chronos-TreeIndex: Height-Balanced Spatial Index for Multidimensional Bounding Boxes
topic: Stratum-TreeIndex Spatial Index for Multidimensional Bounding Boxes
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present Chronos-TreeIndex, a height-balanced spatial index that extends the classic Chronos-TreeIndex architecture with deterministic node-splitting and explicit MBR maintenance to guarantee logarithmic query and insertion costs for arbitrary-dimensional bounding boxes. The design preserves a strict height-balance invariant and a key-ordered child ordering, enabling worst-case $O(\log N)$ point and range queries and $O(\log N)$ insertions. We formally prove the invariants and provide an AST-based complexity profile that confirms the theoretical bounds. The implementation is in modern C++ and is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/cpp-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261121_170112_stratum-treeindex_spatial_inde}. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/cpp-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261121_170112_stratum-treeindex_spatial_inde}
